## Mapping Decisions

- **Type discriminator on `FEATURES.RECORD_TYPE`.** Person-name attributes are kept on PERSON records,
  NAME_ORG on ORGANIZATION records. No source record breaks this, so nothing is dropped by it.
- **Record 3025 is ORGANIZATION (bootcamper decision, 2026-11-14).** The source gave it no RECORD_TYPE and
  stated both NAME_ORG "PRAVENVGUPTA" and NAME_FULL "WONDERLAND", which the analyzer rejects on one record.
  Evidence for ORGANIZATION: Businessowners line, CP- policy number, tax ID. Both names are emitted as NAME_ORG,
  values unchanged. Cost noted at the time: "PRAVENVGUPTA" is also a person name on 3023, and an organization
  cannot resolve with person records.
- **Records 3021 and 3023 stay untyped.** No RECORD_TYPE in the source; each carries person names only.
- **POLICY_NUMBER is payload, not ACCOUNT** (confidence 0.85): unique per record and in no other source.
- **Label-only objects are skipped.** Records 1097 and 1099 have `{"PHONE_TYPE": "MOBILE"}` with no phone
  number; a label with no value is not a feature.
- **Relationships kept as the source states them.** Anchors on 1310, 1311, 1312 (domain CUSTOMERS) and
  1311 → 1310 PARENT_OF are inside this source. 3050 → REFERENCE 3048 (role "Carer") points to the anchor on
  CREDIT_BUREAU record 3048 (corrected 2026-11-14 when CREDIT_BUREAU was profiled; first noted as outside the project).
- **ADDR_FULL and parsed address parts** are both mapped (step-3 warning). No source object mixes them.
- **Cross-source shared-feature check:** first source mapped, so no pairs yet.

## Quality Notes

- Mapped-output quality 66.8 (completeness 56.8, format consistency 88.3, duplicate keys 0%). The bootcamper
  chose to proceed below 70 at both the Phase 1 and the mapping gate.
- Coverage: NAME 100%, ADDRESS 68%, DOB 59%, PHONE 30%, EMAIL 28%, SSN 27%, GENDER 24%, PASSPORT 11%,
  TAX_ID 10%, DRLIC 6%, NPI 3%, NATIONAL_ID 2%.
- `info@ca-state.gov` is shared by 9 records (EMAIL uniqueness 58.6%): a generic address with little
  matching value. One email is in `Name<address>` form (`Maria Sentosa<msentosa@fmail.com>`), kept verbatim.
- Mixed formats kept verbatim: DATE_OF_BIRTH (M/D/YY, M/D/YYYY, YYYY-MM-DD), GENDER (F/M/U and words).
- Analyzer lists TAX_ID_TYPE as "not in default Senzing config". False positive: the Entity Specification defines
  it (Feature: TAX_ID) and the installed 4.4.4 default configuration template lists it under TAX_ID.
- Analyzer G8 warning: 10 ORGANIZATION names "look PERSON" (e.g. "Worldwide Exports"). Reviewed as detector
  false positives; the source types them and they read as business names.
- Gates: analyzer exit 0; verbatim check passes; routing report drops nothing (run with `--payload-fields`,
  because the script otherwise counts payload fields as dropped). These gates are structural; the semantic
  check is Data processing's match-key audit.
